The {{{1}}} is empowered to raise a single [[Declaration]] of [[{{{2}}}]] each summit to the agenda for debate during a [[Conclave session]]. The Civil Service will provide the {{{1}}} with a single writ - to submit their declaration to the Conclave agenda they should complete the writ and hand it to the office of the [[Prefect of the Conclave]] at least one hour before the [[Conclave session]] begins.

Unlike a [[grandmaster]], the {{{1}}} is personally responsible for any [[Declaration#Presentation|presentation]]. While a [[proxy]] may be appointed to deliver the presentation, their declaration is recorded as having come from the {{{1}}}.
